verdict.rationale: An identity-verification platform that ships mobile and web SDKs could plausibly offer a telemetry or analytics opt-out, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any way to opt out. The docs cover workflows, webhooks, authentication, reports and NFC, none of which concern this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
